about: Known pre-v7 exceptions to the v7 lab checks (docs/UI-LAB.md, "The v7 checks"). Each entry is a v6 story or source file that fails a v7 rule today because the v7 kit is not built. w32/kit-v7 must empty this list; CI blocks on any finding it does not name.

reasons.geometry.padding: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (R-space-3); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.geometry.row: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (R-row-1); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.geometry.wrap: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (R-row-1); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.kit.single: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (v7 21, LAB-v7 4); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.orb.edges: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (ORBS.md G6, G7); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.orb.rest: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (v7 10, 21.4; ORBS.md G5); kit-v7 replaces it
reasons.same-component: the v6 component this story draws predates the v7 rule (v7 21, 21.4, LAB-v7 4); kit-v7 replaces it
